mcqs.question: Which of the following lists the metals in the correct order of decreasing reactivity according to the general reactivity series?

options.A: K > Ca > Na > Mg > Al > Zn > Fe > Pb > H > Cu > Ag > Au
options.B: Na > K > Ca > Mg > Al > Zn > Fe > Pb > H > Cu > Ag > Au
options.C: K > Na > Ca > Mg > Al > Zn > Fe > Pb > H > Cu > Ag > Au
options.D: K > Ca > Mg > Na > Al > Zn > Fe > Pb > H > Cu > Ag > Au

mcqs.answer: K > Na > Ca > Mg > Al > Zn > Fe > Pb > H > Cu > Ag > Au
mcqs.explanation: The standard reactivity series from most to least reactive is: K > Na > Ca > Mg > Al > Zn > Fe > Pb > H > Cu > Ag > Au. Option C matches this order. The other options place Na before K or mix up the positions of Ca and Mg, which are common misconceptions.

mcqs.question: When a strip of zinc metal is placed in an aqueous solution of copper(II) sulfate, which of the following best explains what will happen?

options.A: No reaction because zinc is less reactive than copper.
options.B: Zinc will dissolve and copper will be deposited because zinc is more reactive than copper.
options.C: Copper will dissolve and zinc will be deposited because copper is more reactive.
options.D: Both metals will remain unchanged because they are in the same group.

mcqs.answer: Zinc will dissolve and copper will be deposited because zinc is more reactive than copper.
mcqs.explanation: Zinc is higher than copper in the reactivity series, so it can displace copper ions from CuSO₄. Zinc atoms lose electrons to form Zn²⁺, and Cu²⁺ ions gain electrons to form metallic copper, which appears as a reddish deposit. Options A and C reverse the reactivity order, and D is irrelevant because the metals are not in the same group.

mcqs.learning_point: Understand reactions of metals with salt solutions
mcqs.question: Both iron and magnesium are immersed separately in a solution of copper(II) sulfate. Which statement correctly compares the two reactions?

options.A: Both metals will deposit copper, but only iron will dissolve visibly.
options.B: Iron will not react, while magnesium will deposit copper and dissolve.
options.C: Magnesium will deposit copper and dissolve, whereas iron will not cause any visible change.
options.D: Both metals will not react because copper is less reactive than both.

mcqs.answer: Magnesium will deposit copper and dissolve, whereas iron will not cause any visible change.
mcqs.explanation: Magnesium is above copper in the reactivity series, so it displaces copper ions, producing copper metal and Mg²⁺ ions. Iron lies below copper, so it cannot displace copper; the solution remains unchanged. Option B incorrectly states iron does not react (which is true) but omits that magnesium reacts, which is correct; however, option C captures the full comparison accurately. Options A and D are incorrect.

mcqs.question: In a competitive exam, a student is asked: Which metal can be used to extract copper from its ore by a simple displacement method?
mcqs.explanation: Zinc is more reactive than copper, so it can displace copper ions from their compounds (e.g., copper sulfate) in a displacement reaction. Silver and gold are less reactive, and lead is also less reactive than copper, so they cannot be used for this purpose.

mcqs.question: Which of the following correctly states the general reactivity series of some common metals?

options.A: Na > K > Ca > Mg > Al > Zn > Fe > Pb > H > Cu > Ag > Au
options.B: K > Na > Ca > Mg > Al > Zn > Fe > Pb > H > Cu > Ag > Au
options.C: Ca > K > Na > Mg > Al > Zn > Fe > Pb > H > Cu > Ag > Au
options.D: K > Ca > Na > Mg > Al > Zn > Fe > Pb > H > Cu > Ag > Au

mcqs.answer: K > Na > Ca > Mg > Al > Zn > Fe > Pb > H > Cu > Ag > Au
mcqs.explanation: The standard series from most to least reactive is K, Na, Ca, Mg, Al, Zn, Fe, Pb, H, Cu, Ag, Au. Option B lists them in this exact order. The other options misplace Na and K or rearrange other metals, which is a common error.

mcqs.question: Which metal will displace hydrogen from dilute hydrochloric acid?
mcqs.explanation: Zinc is above hydrogen in the reactivity series, so it reacts with dilute HCl to produce ZnCl₂ and hydrogen gas. Copper, silver, and gold are below hydrogen and do not react with dilute acid.

mcqs.learning_point: Understand reactions of metals with salt solutions
mcqs.question: What distinguishes a metal that reacts with a salt solution from one that does not?

options.A: The reacting metal is less reactive than the metal of the salt.
options.B: The reacting metal is more reactive than the metal of the salt.
options.C: Both metals must be from the same group.
options.D: The reaction depends only on the concentration of the solution.

mcqs.answer: The reacting metal is more reactive than the metal of the salt.
mcqs.explanation: A displacement reaction occurs only when the metal placed in the solution is higher (more reactive) in the reactivity series than the metal whose ions are present in the salt. Options A, C, and D are incorrect because they either reverse the reactivity relationship or ignore the series.

mcqs.question: A student wants to choose a metal for making a protective coating that will not corrode easily in air. Based on the reactivity series, which metal is the best choice?
mcqs.explanation: Copper is low in the reactivity series, meaning it does not readily react with oxygen or moisture, making it suitable for corrosion‑resistant applications. Sodium and potassium are highly reactive and would corrode quickly, while iron, though less reactive than the alkali metals, still corrodes (rusts) more readily than copper.
